title: Vector search in PostgreSQL
brief: Evaluate PostgreSQL vector retrieval independently from the meaning assigned by an embedding model.
outcomes: Distinguish semantic relevance from nearest-neighbour recall
Choose exact, HNSW or IVFFlat retrieval under filters and lifecycle cost
entry: PostgreSQL indexes, plan measurement and filtered result semantics.

heading.title: An embedding and a distance
heading.brief: Use labelled toy product vectors only to explain geometry; distinguish these from real model output, model versions, dimensions and distance operators.

heading.title: An exact baseline
heading.brief: Define the eligible filtered set and exact top-k with stable tie handling; separate human relevance judgements from retrieval recall against that baseline.

heading.title: Approximate access
heading.brief: Compare HNSW and IVFFlat build, memory, update and search tradeoffs on a pinned pgvector release; avoid inventing benchmark results from three products.

heading.title: Filters and evolving data
heading.brief: Follow post-filter candidate loss, iterative scans and alternative filtered access; measure recall, latency and resource cost while accounting for model migration and extension operations.
